Definition: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, tsôʼn means a flock of sheep or goats. In Genesis 4:2, Abel was a keeper of sheep, and it appears again in Exodus 2:16.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsôʼn exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
